description: This file defines the StreamSubscriptionManagerAdmin class, which implements IStreamSubscriptionManagerAdmin. It manages stream subscription managers within the Orleans streaming framework, specifically providing access to an explicit stream subscription manager based on the provided provider runtime.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManagerAdmin
classes.description: A class that manages access to stream subscription managers, specifically providing an explicit subscription manager based on the runtime context.

methods.name: GetStreamSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Returns a stream subscription manager instance corresponding to the specified manager type, or throws an exception if the type is not recognized.
